caption:
Apple unveiled HomeView, a $299 smart home hub with a 7-inch display and Siri AI.
It recognizes up to six people and gives each one a personal Home Screen.
Preorders are open now and it ships November 13, taking on Amazon's Echo Show and Google's Nest Hub.

Would you put an Apple screen in your kitchen?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: MacRumors · Photos: Apple, MacRumors, Forbes

slides.headline: Apple just unveiled a $299 home screen that *knows your face* and runs the new Siri AI

image.generate: Vertical photo at night of a dark modern kitchen. On the stone counter stands the small smart display from the first image, a screen on a domed speaker base, its screen lit with a soft photo. A woman in her thirties leans in close to the display, her face lit by the screen, with a surprised, delighted expression, as if the device just recognized her. The woman and the display fill the upper two thirds of the frame, with headroom above her head. The left third of the frame is empty dark background. The bottom third is the dark counter. Blank surfaces, no readable text or labels on any object, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Photorealistic, high contrast, one clear subject. It must look like an unedited real photo from a news agency, not a painting, not digital art, no glow effects.

slides.heading: A *7-inch* hub for your home
paras: Apple unveiled HomeView on Tuesday at its Welcome home event in New York. It is a smart home hub with a 7-inch display on a speaker base.
It costs $299 as a tabletop or wall-mounted model. Preorders are open and it launches November 13. It is not coming to the EU.

slides.heading: It knows *who is looking*
paras: HomeView recognizes up to six people in a household. Each person gets a personal Home Screen with their own content.
Apple's Greg Joswiak said it is "designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user."

slides.heading: Siri AI *moves into the kitchen*
paras: Siri AI can take actions across apps and pull details from Messages, Calendar and Apple Music. Some features need an Apple Intelligence iPhone or iPad.
It also turns web recipes into step-by-step instructions, with hands-free timers and ingredient tracking.

slides.heading: Taking on *Amazon and Google*
paras: HomeView goes up against Amazon's Echo Show and Google's Nest Hub. At $299, it costs more than comparable devices from both.

paras.t: Apple also announced a $149 HomePod mini 2 and a $299 Apple TV 4K with Siri AI.

slides.hook: HomeView ships November 13. Follow to see if Siri AI can finally win the kitchen counter from Alexa.
